events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: On this day in 1996, the iconic rapper Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas, tragically succumbing to his injuries days later. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the profound impact of Tupac Shakur, a voice that defined a generation and whose music continues to resonate.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who tragically passed away on this day in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Still inspiring guitarists worldwide, Jimi Hendrix's innovative sound changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix track?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Album
angles.copy: The one with *that* zebra crossing. 'Abbey Road' still sounds as fresh today as it did on release. Which track is on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy birthday to The Pretenders' legendary frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, who celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Still rocking stages and airwaves, Chrissie Hynde's distinctive voice and attitude are timeless. Celebrate her 75th with us!

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: The iconic Oasis frontman, Liam Gallagher, celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Liam Gallagher's unmistakable vocals and rock 'n' roll swagger continue to make headlines. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Peace Anthem
angles.copy: More than just a song, 'Imagine' remains a powerful message of peace and unity. What does this iconic track mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: Music in Your Pocket
angles.copy: Remember when 1,000 songs in your pocket seemed like magic? The original iPod launched today, revolutionising portable music.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Today marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British spy film franchise.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: From explosive gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, it's James Bond Day! Which Bond film or song is your all-time favourite?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: A visionary artist and advocate for peace, John Lennon's influence remains immense. We remember him on what would have been his 86th birthday.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, John Cleese has given us countless laughs. Happy 87th to a true British comedy legend!

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonders
angles.copy: An eclectic masterpiece, 'The White Album' broke new ground for The Beatles. What's your hidden gem from this iconic record?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing
events.blurb: The music world remembers Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991. He would have been 80.

angles.name: Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury, a showman like no other. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: A pivotal album that saw The Beatles evolve their sound. 'Rubber Soul' remains a timeless classic. What's your favourite track?

events.title: John Lennon's Passing
events.blurb: The world remembers John Lennon, who was tragically killed on this day in 1980. He would have been 86.

angles.name: Remembering Lennon
angles.copy: On this solemn day, we reflect on the immense life and enduring legacy of John Lennon, a true icon of music and peace.
